devdoc.details: Security model:           - ReentrancyGuard on every state-changing function           - Pausable emergency stop controlled by owner           - Checks-Effects-Interactions pattern throughout           - isSeller check on cancel/update prevents griefing by third parties

EnforcedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is paused.

ExpectedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is not paused.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

buyItem(address,uint256).details: Follows Checks-Effects-Interactions:           1. Checks  — price met, not own listing           2. Effects — credit seller proceeds, delete listing           3. Interact — safeTransferFrom NFT to buyer         Reverts when the marketplace is paused.

params.nftAddress: The ERC-721 contract address of the token to buy.

cancelListing(address,uint256).details: Checks the stored seller address, not the current NFT owner. This correctly         allows cancellation even if the underlying NFT was transferred after listing,         and prevents a new token holder from cancelling someone else's listing.

params.nftAddress: The ERC-721 contract address of the listed token.
params.tokenId: The token ID of the listing to cancel.

returns._0: A Listing struct with price and seller. Price is 0 if not listed.
Amount in wei available to withdraw.

listItem(address,uint256,uint256).details: The NFT stays in the seller's wallet. The marketplace must be approved         to transfer it before this call (via ERC-721 approve or setApprovalForAll).         Reverts when the marketplace is paused.

params.nftAddress: The ERC-721 contract address of the token to list.
params.price: The sale price in wei. Must be greater than zero.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pause().details: Only callable by the contract owner. Use in the event of a critical bug.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

unpause().details: Only callable by the contract owner.

updateListing(address,uint256,uint256).details: Emits ItemUpdated (not ItemListed) so off-chain indexers can distinguish         a price change from a brand-new listing. Only the original seller may update.         Reverts when the marketplace is paused.

params.newPrice: The new sale price in wei. Must be greater than zero.
params.nftAddress: The ERC-721 contract address of the listed token.
params.tokenId: The token ID of the listing to update.

withdrawProceeds().details: Pull-over-push pattern: sellers accumulate proceeds in a mapping and         withdraw on demand. This avoids push failures if a seller is a contract.         Balance is zeroed before the transfer (CEI) to prevent reentrancy,         and nonReentrant provides a second layer of defence.

s_listings.details: NFT contract address → Token ID → Listing details

s_proceeds.details: Seller address → Accumulated proceeds in wei (pull-over-push pattern)

devdoc.title: NftMarketplace

ItemBought(address,address,uint256,uint2.notice: Fired when an NFT is purchased.

ItemCancelled(address,address,uint256).notice: Fired when a seller cancels their listing.

ItemListed(address,address,uint256,uint2.notice: Fired when an NFT is listed for sale. Indexed on all three address/id fields         so The Graph can filter by seller, collection, or specific token efficiently.

ItemUpdated(address,address,uint256,uint.notice: Fired when a seller updates their listing price. Separate from ItemListed         so off-chain indexers can distinguish a price change from a new listing.

ProceedsWithdrawn(address,uint256).notice: Fired when a seller withdraws accumulated proceeds.

buyItem(address,uint256).notice: Purchase a listed NFT by sending at least the listing price in ETH.

cancelListing(address,uint256).notice: Cancel an active listing. Only the seller who created the listing may cancel.

getListing(address,uint256).notice: Retrieve the active listing for a specific token.

getProceeds(address).notice: Retrieve the accumulated proceeds available for a seller to withdraw.

listItem(address,uint256,uint256).notice: List an NFT for sale on the marketplace.

pause().notice: Pause the marketplace. Listing, buying, and updating are disabled.         Cancellations and withdrawals remain available so users can recover funds.

unpause().notice: Unpause the marketplace and resume normal operations.

updateListing(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Update the price of an existing listing.

withdrawProceeds().notice: Withdraw all accumulated sale proceeds to the caller's wallet.

userdoc.notice: A non-custodial NFT marketplace. Sellers keep their NFT in their wallet         until a buyer purchases it. The marketplace only holds ETH proceeds —         never the NFTs themselves.
